notes_for_editor: The 1991 rebuild sentence on the marker is split by page advertisements, so the evidence quote takes the sentence after the break. Height_m is the rebuilt 66 ft height; the original was 80 ft. The brief's coordinates (49.48642, -91.61258) sit about 9 km northeast of the marker's own position (49 24.973 N, 91 39.968 W) and do not match the 25 km east site, so they are left unchanged. An Ignace civicweb document (document 4328) mentions dismantling and re-erection at the Ignace site with a $75,000 budget; its date is not in the text read, so it is not cited. A different first lookout in the Ignace area went up in 1930 and is not covered here.
